## Built for the EEA

I built the websites and tools collected in the [EEA Resource Hub](https://hub.entethalliance.org/). The standards and working-group reports are collective EEA work; my contribution here is making the research, tools, and resources accessible on the web.

### Stay current

- **[Ethereum Intelligence](https://intelligence.entethalliance.org/)** — Ethereum protocol change translated into institutional impact, timing, and action for product, engineering, operations, and risk teams.
- **[Policy Friday — Digital Asset Policy Monitor](https://hub.entethalliance.org/ops-policy-friday/)** — Policy Friday: a weekly digest of US regulatory developments in crypto and blockchain, with curated signals from Capitol Hill, the SEC, CFTC, and beyond.
- **[EEA Prospector — RFI & RFP scanner](https://prospector.entethalliance.org/)** — EEA Prospector: public institution requests and tenders for blockchain, distributed ledger, tokenization, and digital identity.
### Research

- **[Tokenized Asset Investor Eligibility Prototype](https://hub.entethalliance.org/rnd-rwa-erc3643-eas/)** — Shibui: an R&amp;D prototype that checks investor eligibility for tokenized real-world assets (ERC-3643) using Ethereum Attestation Service, reusable across issuers.
- **[Ethereum Settlement for AI Agent Payments](https://hub.entethalliance.org/rialto-ap2-eth/)** — Rialto: a research project linking an AI agent&#x27;s approved payment (AP2 protocol) to one exact payment settled on Ethereum.
- **[Directory of EEA Sites on GitHub Pages](https://hub.entethalliance.org/pages-index/)** — Full index of all active and archived EEA GitHub Pages sites: working group specs, research outputs, and reference implementations.
### Learn

- **[Ethereum for Institutions](https://hub.entethalliance.org/ops-finance/ethereum-101.html)** — Understanding Ethereum: from the global computer concept to its architecture and why it works. Multi-language educational resources with interactive visuals.
- **[Global Finance Infrastructure Map](https://hub.entethalliance.org/ops-finance/finance.html)** — How money moves, who controls it, and where Ethereum fits. An interactive visual guide to the world&#x27;s financial plumbing: from central banks to DeFi.
- **[AI Agents on Ethereum Guide](https://hub.entethalliance.org/ops-finance/agents.html)** — Building autonomous agents with Ethereum: how smart contracts enable trustless, programmable systems that act on your behalf.
### Market maps

- **[Institutional Digital Asset Market Map](https://hub.entethalliance.org/ops-finance/institutional-crypto-market.html)** — The institutional landscape: exchanges, custodians, prime brokers, and infrastructure providers powering enterprise crypto adoption.
- **[Digital Asset Custody Guide](https://hub.entethalliance.org/ops-finance/crypto-custody/index.html)** — Institutional guide to digital asset custody: self-custody vs. third-party models, provider categories, decision frameworks, and fiduciary considerations.
- **[Ethereum Layer 2 Network Map](https://hub.entethalliance.org/ops-finance/trellis/index.html)** — Trellis: an interactive map of Ethereum&#x27;s Layer 2 networks, with rollup security stages, stablecoin liquidity, and network relationships at a glance.
- **[Ethereum Solution Catalog](https://hub.entethalliance.org/ops-solution-catalog/)** — Enterprise Ethereum solutions indexed by use case: a living registry of member-contributed implementations and reference architectures.
### Standards &amp; working groups

- **[EthTrust Smart Contract Security Standard](https://hub.entethalliance.org/wg-ethtrust-site/)** — Minimum security audit standards for Ethereum smart contracts: three certification levels, [S], [M], and [Q].
- **[Crosschain Interoperability Standard](https://hub.entethalliance.org/crosschain-interoperability/)** — EEA Working Group standardizing interoperability between distributed ledgers: transferring assets, sending messages, and initiating actions across networks.
- **[Ethereum Privacy Technology Report](https://hub.entethalliance.org/wg-privacy/privacy-report.html)** — EEA Working Group analysis of privacy-enhancing technologies on Ethereum: ZKPs, confidential transactions, and enterprise data protection patterns.
### More tools I built

- **[The EIP Matrix](https://intelligence.entethalliance.org/eip-matrix.html)** — Ethereum proposals translated into implications for infrastructure, product design, cost, and risk.
- **[Ethereum Gas Fee Calculator](https://intelligence.entethalliance.org/gas-simulator.html)** — An interactive model of proposed EIP-2780 transaction-cost changes.
- **[Ethereum Atlas](https://intelligence.entethalliance.org/atlas.html)** — A map of Ethereum upgrade participants, decisions, and institutional participation.

## Writing & research

- **[Ethereum Governance Futures](https://redoudou.github.io/Ethereum-Governance-Futures/)** — My working research draft on Ethereum governance, responsibility, participation, and resilience. Personal research, not an EEA position.
- **[AP2 for Ethereum Settlement — Rialto](https://hub.entethalliance.org/rialto-ap2-eth/)** — My research on binding an AI agent’s payment authorization to an exact Ethereum transaction. An individual research contribution, not an adopted standard.
- **[AI & Operations](https://helloredwan.me/ai-operations.html)** — How I use AI to build tools and operational systems.
- **[State of Privacy on Ethereum for Enterprise](https://hub.entethalliance.org/wg-privacy/privacy-report.html)** — A collaborative EEA working-group report; I led the working group and built its interactive web presentation.
